title: OpenClaw v2026.5.22 + v2026.5.20: Meeting Notes, 4,100× Faster Models, and Smarter Agents
summary: OpenClaw v2026.5.22 ships a meeting-notes plugin, 4,100× faster /models endpoint, Grok web search, and smarter sub-agent context. Full breakdown with upgrade notes.
body_markdown: It might, if your workflows rely on persona or memory files passing to delegated workers. Check any sub-agent pipelines that depend on contextual awareness beyond task definitions. You can explicitly pass additional context files to sub-agents to restore the previous behavior where needed.
